name: r5-a-e2-ringk2
author: solx-loop
description: Lineage A / E2 (H29). K2 (GELU + GRN sum of squares over the fp16 hidden) was issue- and latency-bound, not stream-bound. A register-prefetch K2 floors at 292 us with no math at 64,96 against a 187 us copy. Moving the hidden rows into a shared-memory ring (one 1-D bulk copy per token row, 3-4 stages of 4*TS rows, run-long CTAs of one image, per-run LN stats in shared memory) floors at 212 us. Replacing erff with a 13-instruction A&S erfc form (rcp + ex2 + 4 FMA) cuts the math term. K2 goes 444 -
